page.overview:
What is 2x4?

2x4 is the second song from Metallica's 1996 album Load.

The song's subject matter is about frustration with speaking to a stupid person, possibly linked to the phrase "talking to a 2x4," and the lyric "put the screws in to ya," with James Hetfield joking about the "piece of wood". Other ideas include bitterness/unforgiveness, or the title being a structural note for "2 riffs, 4 times".

Yeah I'm gonna make you, shake you, take you I'm gonna be the one who breaks you Put the screws into ya, yeah my way Yeah, come on, come on, come and make my day Make my day

Yeah Got some hell to pay ya, I steal your thunder The joy of violent movement, pulls you under Ooh bite the bullet, well hard Yea, but I bite harder, so go too far Too far
